description: SEPARATE COLLECTION (not embedded in profiles). Reasons: (1) unbounded growth - a profile document must not grow toward the 16MB limit; (2) projects are queried, paginated, edited and deleted independently on /projects; (3) they are REFERENCED by jobAnalyses.recommendedProjects, resumes.projects and portfolios.orderedProjects - embedding would force N-way duplication.

userId.description: REFERENCE -> users._id. MANDATORY. Every backend query must filter on it so a user can never read or mutate another user's project (IDOR prevention).

techStackNormalized.description: DERIVED via lib/normalize.js. This is what generateMatch() intersects with the job description's extracted skills, and what powers 'most requested skills' analytics. Rebuild on every write.

imageUrl.description: Primary thumbnail. Object-storage URL, never binary.

images.description: Additional gallery URLs shown on the public portfolio.

role.description: The user's role on the project, e.g. 'Full-stack developer'. Feeds the tailored resume bullet.

achievements.description: Quantified outcomes. These become the resume bullet points.

featured.description: User-pinned. Sorts first on the public portfolio when no job-specific ordering applies.

includeInPortfolio.description: The /projects checkbox. false = private, excluded from every generated portfolio and public view.

deleted.description: Soft delete. Keeps historical resumes and analyses referentially meaningful.
